text:
Sam K: Heads-up: opened PR #10234 with a small hotfix for the edge-gateway that should stop the p99 timeout spikes we've seen for the last 30m. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/10234 :eyes:
Alex M: on it. is this a rollback or patch? any impact to existing connections?
Sam K: it's a patch that tightens the conn backoff logic and avoids a tight retry loop. Should be safe for in-place canary. No schema or config changes.
Priya R: CI flaky on integration tests earlier, requeueing now. unit tests passed. I'll re-run the full integration suite and post results.
Lena B: We should canary to us-west first, 5% traffic, watch p50/p95/p99 and error-rate. I'm OK to watch the canary if someone else merges.
Alex M: quick look done — code is small and looks reasonable. left 1 comment about a nil check, but not a blocker. +1 if tests pass.
DeployBot: CI pipeline #build-10234: unit ✅, integration queued, e2e pending. logs: https://ci.redwood/10234/builds/7
Priya R: integration passed on retry, e2e still running but looks green so far.
Sam K: thanks. plan: merge between 16:20-16:30 UTC, canary 5% for 10m, then roll to 50% and full in 30m if stable. Need 1 more approval to merge.
Alex M: I'll give the extra approval once e2e finishes.
Lena B: I'll monitor canary and set an alert dashboard quicklook. If p99 > 300ms or error-rate increases >0.5% we'll rollback.
OncallBot: Incident watcher registered for thread 1991122334. Notifying oncall rotation.
Sam K: sounds good — tagging @Alex M and @Lena B to merge/watch. If anyone hits an issue, we can `kubectl rollout undo deployment/edge-gateway -n prod` or revert the PR.
Priya R: e2e finished ✅. no regressions in smoke tests.
Alex M: approved and merging now.
Sam K: merged and canary started at 16:26 UTC. Lena, will ping here with metrics.
Lena B: initial canary metrics: p50 22ms, p95 110ms, p99 240ms, error-rate stable at 0.12%. holding at 5% for another 8m. :thumbsup:
Sam K: thanks all. will escalate if any regressions. Closing thread after final rollout confirmation.
Lena B: rolled to 100% at 16:45 UTC, metrics steady. closing. :white_check_mark:
